An object of mass 0.80kg is moving in a straight line at a velocity of 2.0m/s. A force is exerted
on the object, in the direction of motion, for a period of 1.0 minute and the velocity of the object
increases to 6.0m/s.
What force is exerted on the object?
A
0.053N
B
0.080N
C
3.2N
D
4.8N
subject: Physics
